summary: Veterinary Pharmacist ki bharti. 02.03.2019 ke vigyapan mein 18 post thi aur Scheduled Tribe ke liye ek bhi nahi. 29.09.2021 ke result mein 18 ke badle 53 niyuktiyan prastavit hui. Petitioners (Prem Singh Brijwal aur anya) ka kehna hai ki vigyapit post se zyada bharti galat hai. Ve HC Division Bench ke 10.05.2012 aur Supreme Court ke 05.10.2016 ke faisle par tike hain. Saath mein WPSS/1500/2021 (S.K. Mandal) aur WPSS/76/2022.
status: 20.10.2021 ka interim order: top 18 ko regular niyukti di ja sakti hai, aur 18 se upar ke har niyukti patra mein likha jaaye ki niyukti writ ke faisle ke adheen hai. Counter (State aur private respondents) aur rejoinder ho chuke. 11.03.2026 ko State counsel ko agli tareekh par behas ka nirdesh. Phir 30.04.2026 tak tareekhein badhti rahi. 12.10.2026 ko Justice Rakesh Thapliyal ke saamne item 35 (stay application ke saath).

pros: Rakhi Ray (2010, para 14): vigyapit sankhya se zyada niyukti "a nullity, inexecutable and unenforceable in law".
Arup Das (2012, para 10): zyada post uplabdh hon tab bhi vigyapit sankhya se upar chayan nahi ho sakta.
Rakhi Ray (para 24): reservation ke liye vacancies pehle tay karna zaroori. 18 mein ST ki ek bhi post nahi aur baad mein 53 bhari gayi, yeh do alag galtiyan hain.
20.10.2021 ke interim order se 18 se upar ki har niyukti writ ke faisle ke adheen hai. Court ne shuru se ise khula rakha.
cons_title: State aur chayanit umeedwar kya kahenge
cons: Prem Singh (1996) ka apvaad: asaadhaaran sthiti mein policy decision se zyada niyukti (Arup Das, para 12). State koi Government Order dikha sakti hai.
18 se upar ke lagbhag 35 umeedwar (agar sab ne join kiya) 2021 se seva mein hain. Court niyukti radd karne ke bajaye aage ke liye nirdesh de sakta hai.
Petitioners ko khud kya raahat chahiye, yeh saaf hona chahiye. Select list mein naam se niyukti ka adhikaar nahi banta (Rakhi Ray, para 26).
Petitioners ki shreni (ST?) aur unka chayan list mein sthaan record par saaf hona chahiye.

53 niyuktiyon ka GO ya policy decision, agar State ne diya ho

similar.title: Rakhi Ray v. High Court of Delhi
similar.why: Vigyapit sankhya se zyada niyukti Article 14 aur 16(1) ke khilaaf aur shoonya. Reservation ke liye vacancies pehle tay karna zaroori (para 24).
similar.quote: “…any appointment made beyond the number of vacancies advertised is without jurisdiction, being violative of Articles 14 and 16(1) of the Constitution of India, thus, a nullity, inexecutable and unenforceable in law.” (para 14)

similar.title: Arup Das v. State of Assam
similar.why: Zyada post uplabdh hon tab bhi vigyapit sankhya se upar chayan nahi. Prem Singh ka apvaad sirf asaadhaaran sthiti mein.
similar.quote: “It is well-established that an authority cannot make any selection/appointment beyond the number of posts advertised, even if there were a larger number of posts available than those advertised.” (para 10)
